global.criterion: Clearly sculpted compact 3D CARTOON educational diorama on warm off-white with believable metal, soil, wood and plastic material texture and generous margins; not a photoreal scene or flat drawing.
No words, letters, numbers, arrows, logos, emblems, labels, watermark or pseudo-writing on any surface.
No human, hand, face, toy character or visible operation; the tools are separate stationary teaching props on a clean table.

s1-04-tool-layout-still.criterion: A clearly hollow straight sampling push tube, separate spiral hand auger, flat spade and small hand trowel are all complete and visibly different; the probe is not a solid rod and the auger is not an undisturbed core tube.
A narrow probe portion and separate thin even vertical spade slice are visible without implying a full shovel load or that ordinary augering preserves undisturbed soil structure.
A clearly plastic clean empty mixing bucket is present and separate from the soil portions; there is no galvanized bucket or residue.
No tool is depicted contacting underground utilities, being forced into the field or as a universal instruction for every soil and laboratory method.
